name: ITO and the Vikas Marg crossing
notes: The crossing layout itself has low confidence on the sheet (no street-level photo of the ITO crossing).

footpath.surface: red-brown interlocking paver with a yellow tactile strip and a planted verge on Bhairon Marg; grey paver, half finished, on Safdar Hashmi Marg; broken concrete along a wall on Todarmal Lane
footpath.kerb: yellow and black painted kerb; black and white at the bus bay
footpath.notes: 2.5 to 3 m on Bhairon Marg, 2 to 2.5 m on Safdar Hashmi Marg, about 1 m on Todarmal Lane; a 535 m skywalk links ITO and Pragati Maidan

lamps.kind: tall steel pole with two curved arms in the median; highmast and curved-arm poles on the flyovers; smaller double-arm poles on the side streets

kinds: red-brown brick wall about 2 m with stone coping and iron gate leaves
yellow police barricades at the crossing mouths

signs.boards: green street-name boards in three scripts on single posts; bill posters and torn flex banners

life.people: office staff, students and journalists crossing on foot, commuters at the bus stops, tea and juice sellers, drivers waiting at the junction mouths

wear_notes: about 0.35 on the main roads, about 0.5 on the side streets

road.condition: asphalt of mixed age, patched and oil-stained, thick white lane lines, faded stop lines and zebra bars; carriageways 10 to 11 m each way with kerbed 2 to 3 m medians

evidence.buildings.mix: sheet ito 'Buildings': government and media slabs (Police Headquarters, Shakti Sadan, PWD, Doordarshan block) in leafy compounds; a few low sheds are an estimate for the service buildings. Shares are an estimate
evidence.buildings.floors: sheet ito 'Street-level top-up' (Shakti Sadan about 10 storeys, PWD and Police 12 to 15, Doordarshan about 8) and 'Buildings' (mixed 4 to 12 floors)
evidence.buildings.colours: sheet ito 'Street-level top-up': grey concrete, blue horizontal bands on Shakti Sadan, orange-brown brick block; 'Buildings': grey and brown concrete
evidence.buildings.materials: sheet ito 'Buildings': concrete, tinted glass, AC boxes; 'Street-level top-up': orange-brown brick
evidence.buildings.wires: sheet ito 'Street-level top-up': heavy overhead cables along the side streets
evidence.buildings.upkeep: sheet ito 'Typical clutter and wear': soot on the flyover underside, bill posters, mud; heavy traffic soils walls and kerbs
evidence.footpath: sheet ito 'Street-level top-up': Bhairon Marg 2.5 to 3 m of red-brown paver with a yellow tactile strip; Safdar Hashmi Marg 2 to 2.5 m, half finished; Todarmal Lane about 1 m; 'Footpaths': a 535 m skywalk
evidence.lamps: sheet ito 'Street lamps' and 'Street-level top-up': tall poles in the median with two curved arms 10 to 12 m high, 35 to 45 m apart, highmast on the flyovers; DELHI_WORLD.md 2a table
evidence.boundaries: sheet ito 'Boundaries' and 'Street-level top-up': flyover railing, concrete parapets, jersey barriers, brick wall about 2 m with stone coping, yellow police barricades
evidence.props: sheet ito 'Street-level top-up' (yellow barricades across the road mouths, bus shelters with large ad panels) and 'Typical clutter and wear' (bill posters, torn flex banners, hoardings, electrical boxes)
evidence.signs: sheet ito 'Street-level top-up': green street-name boards in three scripts on single posts; 'Typical clutter and wear': bill posters, torn flex banners
evidence.life: sheet ito 'Vendors and street life' (office workers, journalists, tea stalls, juice carts, bus stops with crowds), 'Street-level top-up' (students and office staff crossing at the Mandi House mouth, e-rickshaws and autos waiting, a dog asleep on the verge) and 'Parking and vehicles'
evidence.sound: sheet ito 'What makes this area unlike the others': infrastructure scale and noise, closest thing to modern Delhi traffic
evidence.wear: sheet ito 'Typical clutter and wear': wear 0.4; DELHI_WORLD.md 2a table 0.35 on main roads, 0.5 on side streets
evidence.wear_notes: sheet ito 'Street-level top-up': wear on the side streets about 0.5; main roads about 0.35
evidence.road: sheet ito 'Road surface and markings' and 'Street-level top-up': six to eight lanes at the crossing, mixed age asphalt, patched, oil-stained, carriageways 10 to 11 m each way, medians 2 to 3 m
